title: Fanny, with Other Poems

authorInfo.bio: Fitz-Greene Halleck (1790–1867) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Fanny, with Other Poems" by Fitz-Greene Halleck is a collection of poetry written in the early 19th century. The highlighted poem, "Fanny," opens with a reflection on the character of Fanny, exploring themes of beauty, youth, ambition, and the socioeconomic dynamics of her family.
